name: gradient-eternal-constance
title: Eternal Constance
description: A static two-stop gradient block: dark navy along the bottom rising to slate blue at the top, shaped as a full-width rounded panel that can sit behind content or fill a section.
use: You need a calm dark gradient surface behind text or as a section and card fill.
avoid: The colours are fixed in the source, so a light theme or a different palette needs an edit.
a11y: Decorative gradient with no interactive content, so there is nothing to focus, label or announce. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle centred on a near-black stage, filled with a smooth vertical gradient. The top edge is a soft grey-blue and it darkens steadily to almost black-navy at the bottom, with softly rounded corners.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The same gradient is shown in every frame.
customise: Pass className or style to change size and override the gradient; the two colour stops are written into the file.
weight: light: A single div painted with one CSS gradient; no script or animation.
issues: Packet calls the footprint full-bleed but the frames show a rounded panel inset from the stage.
polishWhy: Clean smooth gradient with even corners; ordinary and nothing distinctive.
